overview_description.description: They've set out to modernize healthcare recruiting. They're a team of physicians and entrepreneurs who have come together to solve a major pain point facing medical professionals today. Healthcare is a noble profession that has become overburdened by loss of autonomy, administrative bloat, and an ever-increasing number of intermediaries widening the gap between patients and providers. They want to help realign the industry around its original purpose and let providers administer better care.

about_short_description.short_description: DirectShifts is a healthcare labor marketplace, connecting healthcare workers with organizations for contract/per-diem/full time work

product.name: DirectShifts Healthcare Labor Marketplace Platform
product.description: A digital platform connecting healthcare workers with employers for contract, per diem, and full-time jobs across various specialties and locations.

product.name: DirectShifts Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows healthcare professionals to search jobs, manage applications, track shifts, and handle documents on the go.

product.name: DirectShifts Document Wallet
product.description: A secure digital tool for clinicians and employers to store, share, and manage healthcare documents in real time.

product.name: Internal Resource Pool Solution
product.description: A staffing solution that helps healthcare organizations build and manage a pool of pre-credentialed clinicians to reduce reliance on costly contract staff.

product.name: DirectShifts Referral Program
product.description: A program that rewards healthcare professionals for referring qualified candidates who complete shifts or contracts through DirectShifts.

product.name: Continuing Medical Education (CME) Partnerships
product.description: Collaborations offering clinicians discounted access to continuing medical education courses and credit programs.
